show.description: Aditya’s life shatters when his girlfriend leaves him on their wedding day for a richer man. In a twist of fate, he impulsively marries Preeti Shetty, a strong and mysterious woman. What begins as a sudden marriage turns into a journey of love, betrayal, and destiny. As secrets unfold, Aditya discovers he is actually Siddharth Sharma, the lost heir of a powerful family, leading to a battle for identity, love, and legacy.
